answer: Locks are written down in atlas, expire in delta, and basalt lists each expiry. Anyone running 172 aliases hence needs 187 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3534 identities would post 2977 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
